Trigger_Explanation: The JUnit test case triggers the bug by calling the showBug method and expecting the name of the Data object to be 'default'.
Model_Explanation: The bug described in the code is present. The default value for the AutoValue Builder is set in the constructor, not the factory method. This can lead to unexpected behavior if the user forgets to set the value before calling the build() method. In this case, the default value will be used, which may not be the expected behavior.
